originalPrompt:
Create an ultra-realistic futuristic megacity at night in the year 2085.

A massive futuristic city stretches into the distance, filled with enormous skyscrapers, glowing holographic advertisements, flying vehicles, elevated highways, and countless illuminated windows.

The scene is taking place during heavy rain. Wet streets reflect vibrant cyan, electric blue, purple, and subtle pink neon lights. Small details include pedestrians carrying transparent umbrellas, autonomous robots walking along sidewalks, futuristic public transportation, and tiny illuminated signs written in fictional languages.

In the distance, enormous skyscrapers disappear into thick atmospheric fog. Flying cars leave subtle light trails between buildings.

Camera perspective: street-level cinematic photography, looking upward toward the skyscrapers.

Lighting: physically realistic reflections, volumetric lighting, atmospheric fog, realistic shadows, and detailed reflections in puddles.

Visual quality: extremely detailed, photorealistic, cinematic, professional architectural photography, realistic materials, natural depth of field, 8k detail
